sources: Xiranflow (3 pieces). rmxlinux Json/SkillData/passive_equipsuit_expend_spell01 (SkillPatchTable level 1: atk_up 0.1, spell_dmg_up 0.15, duration 25, max_stack 3): cardAttributeModifier ATK +atk_up is a stat-panel modifier. Its `buffs` give the wearer buff_equipsuit_expend_spell01: abilityEvent 208 (a buff removed by the wearer) + CheckBuffIdInContextAdvanced tags 1466867135 / -421286163 (Electrification, Corrosion) → GetTargetBuffBBAdvanced `count` of the consumed status (its Status Level) → CreateBuffAction buff_equipsuit_expend_spelldamage with that count (stackingType 2, max max_stack, each layer its own `duration`): Electric (attr 52) and Nature (attr 54) DMG +spell_dmg_up per layer. "Whenever the wearer consumes Electrification or Corrosion, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the Status Level of the Arts Reaction consumed … Max {max_stack}. Duration of each stack is counted separately." Batch-2 report docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0022_bounda.md rows S5-S7.

What "consumes" covers (a hit removing the status, or also one replaced or running out) is open: the engine's statusConsumed is a hit removing it before it runs out (report row S7); no log has a wearer that consumes Electrification or Corrosion yet.

buffs.label: Electric and Nature DMG (Xiranflow)
buffs.note: Layered (stackingType 2): each layer has its own 25 s; at max_stack a new one replaces the oldest.

triggers.note: One layer per Status Level of the consumed status (the event's count).
